Overview

The economics of Agentic AI & Hyperautomation for Retail & Consumer Goods flipped in the last two years: runtimes got durable, evaluation became routine, and orchestration frameworks matured into something you can run under change control. What separates winners now is integration discipline — how cleanly the capability plugs into commerce & POS estates without inventing a shadow estate. What makes Retail & Consumer Goods different is not the math; it is the operating context: GDPR / privacy regimes governs the data, fresh waste governs the economics, and the people accountable for outcomes answer to regulators as well as customers. Every design choice below is downstream of that context.
